decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P1 — Save a bookmark: add a link ... it persists'. R2 maker confirms FR-001. Client never contests saving-by-url.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Save-by-url conforms to reference; recorded in-scope conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P2 — Edit & delete: correct titles/addresses'. Client does not contest edit capability.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Editing a bookmark conforms; in-scope conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'delete with a safeguard against accidents'. Not contested.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Delete-with-safeguard conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P3 — Organize with tags: label bookmarks'. Client accepts tagging (only adds autocomplete separately).
decisions.note: Spec gate. Assigning tags conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'label bookmarks and filter by tag'. Not contested.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Filter-by-tag conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents only manual 'add a link (with optional title/notes)' — no auto-collection. R1 client: 'Saving a link should automatically collect its title, description, favicon, and preview image. I should be able to edit the title and description before or after saving.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 scope omitted auto-metadata (reference REF-BM-02/03); client requests the missing reference requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker lists duplicates only as an 'edge case'. R1 client: 'Saving an address that already exists should take me to the existing bookmark for editing, not merely warn me.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client rejects the warn behavior and supplies the reference-conforming 'open existing for editing' (REF-BM-06) -> correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'list all bookmarks' (no row detail). R1 client: 'Each bookmark in the list should clearly show its title, description, tags, and favicon.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Readability-first rich rows (REF-BM-07) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search by keyword across title/address'. R1 client: 'Search should cover the title, description, notes, and address, without caring about capitalisation.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 search omitted description/notes and case-insensitivity (REF-BM-12/13); client extends the search scope -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: keyword search only. R1 client: 'I also want ... #tag searches'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. #tag search (REF-BM-14) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: keyword search only. R1 client: 'combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and brackets'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Boolean/parenthesised operators (REF-BM-15) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend. (Quoting-literal sub-rule handled later at R2.)

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: keyword search only. R1 client: 'I also want exact phrases'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker offers tags without suggestions. R1 client: 'When entering tags, existing tags should be suggested.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no read-later. R1 client: 'I need a read-later state, with a separate unread view and the ability to mark items read.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Unread state/view/mark-read (REF-BM-17/18/19) absent from R1; client requests missing requirements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'list all bookmarks' (no sort). R1 client: 'I need sorting, including by date added and title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Sorting (REF-BM-22) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no bulk actions. R1 client: 'I should be able to select several bookmarks—or all bookmarks matching my current search or filter—and add or remove tags, mark them read or unread, archive them, or delete them.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bulk on selection and on all-matching-filter (REF-BM-20/21) absent from R1; client requests missing requirements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope: 'no page archiving' and no archive feature. R1 client: 'Archiving must be reversible and distinct from deleting. Archived bookmarks should be hidden from the normal list and search, with their own view.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reversible archive distinct from delete + own view (REF-BM-26/27/28) absent from R1; client requests missing requirements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: plain notes only. R1 client: 'Notes should support simple formatting and display it properly.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Markdown/formatted rendered notes (REF-BM-23) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no saved filters. R1 client: 'Please include saved filters that combine a search with included or excluded tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bundles/saved filters (REF-BM-29) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope: 'no page archiving'. R1 client: 'I want an offline copy of a page preserved where possible; PDFs should be saved as PDFs. I'd also like the option to preserve a copy through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Local snapshot incl. PDF rule + Internet Archive (REF-BM-24/25) explicitly excluded in R1; client requests missing requirements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope: 'no import/export'. R1 client: 'Import and export should support the common browser bookmark HTML format while retaining titles, tags, and saved dates.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Netscape HTML import/export (REF-BM-30/31) explicitly excluded in R1; client requests missing requirements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no preferences. R1 client: 'Include personal display preferences such as default sorting, how much is shown, and text size.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Display preferences (REF-BM-32) absent from R1; client requests missing requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker presents FR-015 as 'AND/OR/NOT/brackets' with no literal-escape rule. R2 client: 'AND, OR, and NOT should act as operators. If I want one of those words treated as ordinary text, I should be able to put it in quotation marks.'
decisions.note: Spec gate, later revision. R2 presentation of REF-BM-15 omitted the reference quoting-literal sub-rule; client supplies the reference-conforming behavior -> correct. Same requirement as R1 boolean decision but a new revised presentation; resolved and approved at R3.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker plan 'appears to create the bookmark first and collect its details afterward'. R4 client: 'I need to see and edit the automatically collected title and description before I confirm the initial save. ... adjust the plan to include that review step.'
decisions.note: Plan gate. Plan's create-then-fetch flow mismatched REF-BM-03 (edit before saving); client supplies the reference-conforming pre-save review flow -> correct. Resolved and approved at R5.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker tasks: 'the confirmed save carries only the address, title, description, and tags' (per client's reading). R6 client: 'The collected favicon and preview image also need to be saved with the bookmark so they remain available after reloading.'
decisions.note: Tasks gate. Task-level save payload dropped favicon/preview persistence, partial on REF-BM-02; client supplies the reference-conforming persistence -> correct. Same requirement as R1 metadata decision, later stage.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker analysis flags G1: FR-009 'open a saved bookmark's target page has no explicit task; T022 renders rows but doesn't state the title/URL is an actual clickable link'. R7 client: 'Also include a check that selecting the bookmark's title or address opens the original page.'
decisions.note: Tasks/analysis gate. Selecting an item to navigate to the original url (REF-BM-08) was missing/partial in the task scope; client requests the requirement plus an e2e check -> extend. Resolved in R8 implementation.
